basics.name: Nutan Prabhat
basics.label: Software Engineer, Backend & Full-Stack
basics.summary: Software engineer with 4+ years building and owning backend and full-stack systems in Python and C#. At Aziro I worked directly with an enterprise client as sole engineer and raised a retrieval system's Top-1 accuracy from 41.9% to 97.7%. At Zenoti, on a 500+ page multi-tenant SaaS product used by 30,000+ businesses, I worked on UI revamp, added an integration layer to localization and restored degraded SQL queries. I build with Claude Code daily and am learning agents and RAG with LangChain and LangGraph.

work.name: Aziro (formerly MSys Technologies)
work.summary: Sole engineer on the account. Python throughout, scoping to handover.
highlights: Sole engineer on an enterprise client account, owning scoping, HLD/LLD, build, test, documentation and handover.

Raised Top-1 accuracy of a two-stage visual retrieval system from 41.9% to 97.7% by growing the feature-based reranker from 3 to 8 features and tuning it against MRR, with CLIP ViT-B/16 embeddings in Qdrant handling recall.

Automated 3+ manual workflows by delivering a config-driven Python desktop CAD validation platform end to end, with DXF parsing, 2D computational geometry, PySide6, a JSON rule engine with audit trails and a client integration.
Replaced manual CAD-variation work with rule-based geometry augmentation that heals the 2D geometry.

work.summary: Unity and C# on the client, server-side JavaScript on Unity Cloud Code.
highlights: Reached 10K+ downloads and 500+ MAU with no paid ads by shipping Pen Fight 2D, a turn-based Unity game.
Built a serverless, server-authoritative economy on Unity Cloud Code and integrated Google Cloud auth and APIs.
Architected online multiplayer and friend challenges on Unity Lobby and Relay, and built a master-follower physics simulation that handles race conditions on nearly every action.

work.name: Zenoti
work.summary: Backend and full-stack work on a large multi-tenant enterprise product.
highlights: Flagged 40+ would-be defects as primary code reviewer, reached in just over a year, requesting changes on 25+ of 50+ PRs including senior-approved work, and mentored teammates on defect resolution.
Restored SQL queries degraded 2 to 3x to near-baseline response times with no downtime, by adding an index and gating a stored procedure's longer path behind a setting.

Designed and owned a localization integration layer in JavaScript and C# that launched with 5+ languages, with providers switchable by configuration, per-element opt-out and coverage through the API and database layers.

awards.title: HackerRank Orchestrate, October 2026: rank 176 of 4,094 (top 5%) in a 24-hour AI agent hackathon
awards.summary: HackerRank's 24-hour challenge asked for an AI agent that works out whether a company really deleted someone's data, scored across 518 requests, using logs, database snapshots, PDFs and screenshots. The submission combined a deterministic audit engine with Claude reading free-text requests in several languages, PDFs and screenshots, and a critic reviewing every finished answer. The critic caught 76 of 79 seeded faults, and 10 held-out samples, never opened, scored 0.848 against 0.851 on development samples. Built with Claude Code, with four reviewer agents at each stage. Model cost for the final run was about $16.

awards.title: HackerRank Orchestrate, September 2026: rank 224 of 3,062 (top 8%) in a 24-hour AI agent hackathon
awards.summary: HackerRank's 24-hour challenge asked for an AI agent that decides whether someone can safely afford a purchase, scored across 250 requests. The submission combined a deterministic 90-day cash-flow engine, including a verifier that re-simulated every recommendation, with Claude reading 16 receipts and payslips and classifying 215 messages in two languages. Eight tagged versions each tested one hypothesis against 25 solved examples. Model cost for the full run was about $3.
